# Local decoder changes (PhotoCraft)

Base: crates.io ruzstd0.9.0, MIT, original source retained except replaced optimized raw-pointer ring implementation. No GIMP/GEGL or proprietary implementation is involved. Unsafe is forbidden; ring uses safe initialized VecDeque storage.

Changes: complete compressed sequence/literal-tail regenerated length is checked before history pushes/repeats. Encoded and decoded raw/RLE blocks and regenerated literals must fit min(frame window,128KiB). Oversized plans return typed RegeneratedBlockTooLarge without ring mutation. This closes the malformed compressed-sequence allocation gap in upstream sequence_execution.

Allocation scope for the optional PhotoCraft decoder: StreamingDecoder receives max_window before initialization and caller reads at most4096 bytes. Thus before decoding another block the uncollected ring length is below window+4096; one validated block adds at most128KiB. Ring growth old/new overlap must be included. Literal and block buffers are <=128KiB; sequence header is representably98047 entries but rejects count>min(window,128KiB)/3 before reserve (every match>=3); each entry is threeu32 values (12bytes); FSE logs LL9/ML9/OF8, Huffman11 with its weight FSE6. The caller prepays fourwindow+8MiB logical decoder envelope, separate from encoded and decoded output capacities. Standard dependency allocations are not an RSS census or a fallible allocator guarantee. Ring growth uses try_reserve_exact and verifies actual capacity against the checked next-power-of-two envelope; frame buffer census verifies actual retained capacities against the caller temporary lease after each block. Standard FSE/Huffman/literal/sequence Vec constructors still use standard allocator semantics.

Regression sources: original overblock sequence test failed against unbounded execution before the change; exact128KiB and cumulative-overblock+literal-tail cases, complete malformed literals frame, missing dictionary, independent zstd compressed500000-byte multiblock output, small-window refusal. Existing44 non-corpus internal/encoder/table tests also run. Upstream binary corpus tests are retained behind upstream-corpus-tests because the crates.io package omits their include_bytes inputs; no PhotoCraft corpus route is skipped.



Borrowed block control: additive decode_blocks_with_poll/read_with_poll polls before and after each validated block, including history fill; legacy methods wrap a no-op callback. Callback is never retained. Exact maximum valid43690-sequence/128KiB block measured1.678ms in the final release probe (earlier1.899ms); this does not qualify allocation/syscall or total-import latency. Final52 tests include failed-grow/history preservation,16MiB declared window boundary and history-fill control failure before output publication. PhotoCraft's actual optional decoder separately preserves Work/Cancelled and refunds all temporary/output reservations.
